import subprocess
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path


PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DIFFICULTIES = {
    "1": ("Easy", 6, 6, 6),
    "2": ("Medium", 9, 9, 12),
    "3": ("Hard", 12, 12, 24),
}


class StartupMenuTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_menu_and_selected_board_configuration(self):
        for choice, (name, rows, cols, mines) in DIFFICULTIES.items():
            with self.subTest(difficulty=name):
                result = subprocess.run(
                    [sys.executable, str(PROJECT_ROOT / "main.py")],
                    input=f"{choice}\nq\n",
                    capture_output=True,
                    text=True,
                    cwd=PROJECT_ROOT,
                    check=False,
                    timeout=10,
                )

                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
                for option, (difficulty, board_rows, board_cols, mine_count) in DIFFICULTIES.items():
                    self.assertIn(
                        f"{option}. {difficulty} ({board_rows}x{board_cols}, {mine_count} mines)",
                        result.stdout,
                    )
                self.assertIn(f"Difficulty: {name}", result.stdout)

                header = " ".join(str(column) for column in range(1, cols + 1))
                lines = result.stdout.splitlines()
                header_index = next(
                    index
                    for index, line in enumerate(lines)
                    if line.startswith("   ") and line.strip() == header
                )
                board_lines = lines[header_index + 1:header_index + 1 + rows]
                self.assertEqual(len(board_lines), rows)
                for row_number, line in enumerate(board_lines, start=1):
                    cells = line.split()
                    self.assertEqual(cells[0], str(row_number))
                    self.assertEqual(len(cells) - 1, cols)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
